rubric.overall: 2 = sufficient correct answer with exact relevant citation support; 1 = useful partial, epistemic or citation defect; 0 = fails task recall or materially misleads. Safe abstention is distinct from usefulness.
rubric.axis_scale: 0 absent/wrong; 1 partial; 2 sufficient/correct; null not applicable or not measured. false_closures=2 means no false closure.
rubric.applicability: Only question-relevant axes; no positive scope/merge-reliability score for an empty-context abstention. Source-record support assessed semantically against exact supplied references, not keyword matches. A metadata wrapper citation is unsupported as a record ID but is not a critical fabricated-world-evidence claim when answer only discusses missing context.
rubric.world_status: Reported local checks remain reported evidence. User decision/correction establishes approved intent, not implementation or production verification.
not_measured: Whether context retrieval later repairs omissions

aggregate.summary: 11 sufficient answers and 39 safe unsuccessful abstentions; no partial answers. Substantive recovered answers preserve ZIP rationale, accepted seven/local-only correction, recording-credit/license obligation or unknown production version with exact supporting citations. Every continuation, distinct-task negative, same-chat topic-separation, practical-resume, delayed-event and full-environment-summary case fails task recall because the supplied context contains only metadata/freshness notices. No answer falsely closes work, merges tasks, contaminates environments/versions or fabricates a project fact; non-record wrapper citations are flagged separately.
aggregate.limits: First held-out code run after earlier developmental regressions, not preregistered. No inference about post-repair quality. Mode-label blinding only; context format visible and fixture author performed grading. Ten question families share one fictional frozen history, so 50 cases are not 50 independent projects. No network/native calls or production edits were made.
